reference_scope: W32 dedicated HCP arithmetic/phase candidate only;247.885us is not a lower bound or complete timing for the GPU comparator. No dedicated HCP adoption inferred.

current_model_budget.scope: Existing modeled budget in SM_ELEM and sm_area; not measured or implemented general FP32 service.

implemented_sm_top.note: ot_gpu_sm_v instantiates matrix columns, x SRAM, bulk-copy, issue, trees/stacks. FP32 accumulators/results do not establish a general FP32 coefficient multiply/SU instruction path. Full FP32 HC coefficients cannot be passed through BF16 weight conversion.

historical_model_scope.note: hbm_gpu_design v41 historically includes ROM proposal dedicated units. Preserve old record; do not carry this organization into the required GPU-mapped comparator without explicit new model.

service_contract_required: Map full-F32 HC coefficient multiply/add and exact chunk8/tree order onto modeled GPU FP32 SIMT resources; bind instruction latencies, issue/warp schedule and available lanes.
Map full-shape SU, norm, SFU sigmoid/rsqrt and Sinkhorn loops to the same SM/RF/shared-memory organization; N256 span legality is not TP96 GPU lowering.
Price RF capacity/ports and shared-memory bank capacity/ports for coefficients, activations, partials, indices, scores and workspaces; give liveness and allocation, not free staging.
Bind coefficient/state/table DMA and matrix-weight refill to finite shared controllers, bulk-copy credits, NoC routes and arbitration; no hidden overlap.
Price standard GPU ALU/SFU/RF/shared-memory additions if existing modeled budgets are insufficient; no independent ROM-specific HCP block.
Include all service/barrier/write-completion dependencies in full-token graph and area/slot/tracks before build; require connected complete cycles before rate credit.

candidate_illustration.note: Arithmetic illustration only. Assumes all32SM scratch resources devoted to one HC operation; no RF, partial, SFU, selection, matrix staging or port conflict allowance. Does not prove fit or legal distributed reduction.
